answer: Admission auctions price sybil identities out of the market. Each epoch only 80 seats open, and applicants bid in a sealed auction; the clearing price is public, bids lock for 3 epochs, and a 2-epoch window lets anyone challenge a fake identity and burn its bid. At a 60-unit clearing price, 1,000 fake identities cost 60,000, and doubling demand doubles the price. The kernel of the defense is that attackers must outbid each other, while the glacier-slow refund keeps capital frozen and saffron-flagged challenges keep every seat honest.
